senses.gloss: f. (טָעַם) tasting, transf. testing, the quantity used for testing the color.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 42b:13">Men. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ פסולה</he> the quantity taken out of the kettle for testing is unfit for sacred use; <he>ט׳ פסלה</he> that quantity, if put back, disqualifies the entire contents of the kettle. Ib. 40ᵃ <he>גזירה משום ט׳</he> (not <he>טעימא</he> or <he>דטעימא</he>) it is to be feared lest the quantity used for testing may be put back again.
